g.text: Extract everything under src/auth into its own service module.

g.text: Message your agent… (Enter to send · @ for files · / for commands · ! for terminal)
Queue a follow-up… (Enter to send · it runs after the current turn)
req.ip is spoofable behind the proxy
Express only falls back to the socket address once trust proxy
is set — until then a client can just rotate X-Forwarded-For.
Keys are pruned only when the same key comes back — a login
flood leaves one entry per IP for the process lifetime.
Using <= here lets the 6th request through when limit = 5.
Rate limiting is the right call and the window
logic reads correctly. Two things to settle
before merge: the map never shrinks, and req.ip
Nothing fires limit + 1 requests inside one
window, so an off-by-one ships silently.
Three agents, three isolated worktrees — the easy part.
Work that builds on work? Stack the agents.
Each PR targets its parent — the whole chain in one place.
Parent merges → Wooi rebases and retargets the rest.
Review a PR here too — findings land on the diff line.
Edit it, discard it, post one or post the batch.
